runtime_limitations: Runtime limitation: Pyramidal tossups are a real-time buzz race against an opposing team; without a live opponent and a buzzer clock, the core scoring mechanic (early buzz versus neg risk) does not exist.
Runtime limitation: Power marks, 3-second answer windows, and 5-second bonus windows are wall-clock mechanisms with no turn-based equivalent.
Runtime limitation: Moderator prompting and answer-acceptability judgments are human calls that a string matcher approximates poorly.
